verdict.rationale: Asking whether a local AI desktop app ships an official CLI is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a desktop app, a local OpenAI-compatible API server and MCP integration. None of these is an official command-line interface; the API server is at most an adjacent building block, and the build-script line (jan-gh-7) is a developer setup step, not a product CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
